GU_ZHEN_REN_RUBILD_CARD_YUE_GUANG_GU.det:
A Light Dao attack Gu, and the source of the companion card [gold]Moonblade[/gold].
Activate: costs 1 Yuan Qi; only 1 activation per entry into Active Gu.
Cooldown: enters Gu Cooldown for 2 turns, then joins Gu Waiting and refills empty Active Gu slots in order.
Scaling: damage = 5 + rank (6 at rank 1, 14 at rank 9).
Companion: each Moonlight Gu brings 1 Moonblade into the permanent deck; if it is consumed as a [gold]fusion[/gold] material, that Moonblade is lost with it.
Acquisition: 2 copies in the starting deck; also from card rewards.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RUBILD_CARD_YU_PI_GU.title: Jade Skin Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_RUBILD_CARD_YU_PI_GU.detailD:

Cooldown: enters Gu Cooldown for 2 turns, then joins Gu Waiting and refills empty Active Gu slots in order.

Companion: each Jade Skin Gu brings 1 Jade Skin Armor into the permanent deck; if it is consumed as a [gold]fusion[/gold] material, that armor is lost with it.
Acquisition: 1 copy in the starting deck; also from card rewards.

GU_ZHEN_REN_RUBILD_CARD_YUE_YING_GU.deta:
A fusion result Gu; it cannot be obtained directly and never appears in card rewards.
Recipes: 2× Moonlight Gu; or Blood Malice Gu + Iron Armor Gu (both materials need rank 2 or higher).
Fusion: pick [gold]Fusion[/gold] at a rest site and commit the materials; the result rank is the highest rank among them.
Activate: costs 1 Yuan Qi; only 1 activation per entry into Active Gu.
Cooldown: 3 turns in Gu Cooldown (1 turn longer than a regular Gu).
Scaling: damage = 9 + rank × 2 (11 at rank 1, 27 at rank 9).
Note: consuming Moonlight Gu as a material also removes its [gold]Moonblade[/gold] companion.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RUBILD_CARD_XUAN_TIE_GU.deta:

Activate: costs 1 Yuan Qi; only 1 activation per entry into Active Gu.
Cooldown: 3 turns in Gu Cooldown (1 turn longer than a regular Gu).
Scaling: Block = 12 + rank × 3 (15 at rank 1, 39 at rank 9).
Note: consuming Jade Skin Gu as a material also removes its [gold]Jade Skin Armor[/gold] companion.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RUBILD_CARD_SHA_ZHAO_TUI_YAN: Pay 1 Energy. Choose a killer move and its Gu materials to [gold]derive[/gold]. Cancelling or failing costs nothing. The derived move's first play is free; once spent, its materials enter a full [gold]cooldown[/gold] plus 1 extra turn.

A system card: it is in no card pool, never appears in card rewards, and cannot be upgraded.
Granted: from aperture rank 3 onward it is added to your hand at the start of every combat, without consuming an opening draw.
Retain: it is not discarded at the end of the turn, so it can be kept for later turns.
Play: pay 1 Energy, choose the killer move to derive, then choose the matching Gu materials; materials are taken only from [gold]Active Gu[/gold] and [gold]Gu Waiting[/gold] — Gu Cooldown and Sealed Gu are excluded.
Success: pay extra [gold]Yuan Qi[/gold] equal to the rounded-up average Yuan Qi cost of the chosen materials; the materials are sealed in the [gold]Sealed Gu[/gold] zone, the killer move joins your hand with a free first play, and this card is then exhausted.
Closure: once the killer move is spent, its materials leave the sealed zone for Gu Cooldown, cooling from zero plus 1 extra turn; while sealed they take no part in refilling or cooldown.
Cancelling or failing: the cost is refunded in full and this card returns to your hand.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RUBILD_CARD_QING_TI_XIAN_YUA:
[gold]Immortal Essence[/gold] · [blue]{RemainingActivationUnits}[/blue]/[blue]{ActivationUnits}[/blue] channeling units left
Play: consume 1 unit to refill Yuan Qi.
Channeling Gu of rank 6+ spends extra essence units; once depleted, this card stays but cannot be used.

A system card: it is in no card pool, never appears in card rewards, and cannot be upgraded.
Granted: once the aperture reaches rank 6 (the immortal stage), a rank-matched essence is granted into [gold]Active Gu[/gold] at the start of every combat, without consuming an opening draw or an Active Gu slot.
Denomination: 2 channeling units in total.
Play: consume 1 unit to refill Yuan Qi up to its current maximum; this card then returns to Active Gu.
Channel surcharge: each activation of a rank 6+ Gu spends extra essence units on top of Yuan Qi (1/2/4/8 at ranks 6/7/8/9), deducted from the smallest denomination first.
Depletion: once the units run out, this card stays in Active Gu as a dead card that can no longer be played or spent, until the combat ends.

GU_ZHEN_REN_RUBILD_CARD_YUE_GUANG_COMPAN:
The permanent companion card of [gold]Moonlight Gu[/gold]. It belongs to the normal card system: it uses the normal hand and draw piles, costs Energy, and supports native upgrades and enchantments — it occupies no [gold]Active Gu[/gold] or [gold]Gu Waiting[/gold] slot.
Effect: deal 6 damage; upgrading adds 3 (9). The cost is unchanged.
Binding: each Moonlight Gu brings 1 separate Moonblade (2 Moonlight Gu → 2 Moonblades); if the source Gu is consumed as a fusion material, its Moonblade is lost with it.
Acquisition: never from card rewards; only brought in by Moonlight Gu.
